summary.text: Nick Germana is a Democratic state representative from Cheshire District 15 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists him as a professor of history and book writer.

paragraphs.text: Nicholas Germana earned a Ph.D. in European intellectual history from Boston College in 2006.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working as a professor of history at Keene State College and as a book writer.
Germana assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 4, 2024, representing Cheshire 15.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists him as assigned to the Environment and Agriculture Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 general election ballot for Cheshire 15, a two-seat district.
